intro: Every public meeting where this county's decisions get made — computed live, sourced like everything else here. These rooms are open to you, and most of them are nearly empty. Showing up counts double when almost nobody does.

recurring.name: Clark County Quorum Court — regular session
recurring.place: District Courtroom, Clark County Courthouse, 401 Clay St, Arkadelphia
recurring.note: The eleven justices who vote the county budget. Public; residents are routinely given time to speak. Special sessions and committee meetings are additional — watch the county's notices.
recurring.source: Time and room from the court's own 2025–26 minutes, archived in our document library.

recurring.name: Arkadelphia Board of Directors
recurring.note: The board that adopts the city budget the public has never seen posted. Meetings are open.
recurring.source: Schedule per the city's own meeting announcements at arkadelphia.gov.

unverified.name: Arkadelphia School Board · Gurdon School Board
unverified.note: Schedules being verified against the districts' own postings — listed the moment they're confirmed. Board meetings are public; millage is the biggest line on your tax bill.

seasonal.banner: Budget season: between now and December, the quorum court writes next year's county budget. Anything you want changed in the numbers gets said in these meetings — or waits a year.

community.invite: Community events belong here too — recycling drives, cleanups, blood drives, anything neighbors do together. Send it through the question box with the date and place, and it gets listed after a quick review. Listings are free and stay free.
